title: Boulder Joyride Guided eBike Tour
overview: The Boulder Joyride eBike Tour best illustrates why Boulder is one of the best cities on earth for riding bikes. From our centrally-located starting point, we'll take to bike paths, streets, alleys and other byways on this comprehensive, local's-eye view of Boulder. We'll explore the town's eclectic neighborhoods, visit popular (and lesser known) areas of interest, take in stunning views, and immerse ourselves in Boulder's vibrant outdoor culture. title: Guided eBike Tour of Rocky Mountain National Park
overview: Explore the breathtaking Rocky Mountain National Park on a guided eBike tour from Grand Lake to the Alpine Visitor Center along the iconic Trail Ridge Road. This adventure allows riders of all abilities to ascend through lush forests and meadows, soaking in the rich wildlife and history shared by local guides. Experience the stunning transformation of the landscape as you gain elevation, from dense pine forests to expansive alpine tundra, where breathtaking vistas await. Enjoy multiple stops for wildlife viewing, storytelling, and photography at highlights like Milner Pass and Rainbow Curve. Guided eBike tour suitable for all skill levels Ride along historic Trail Ridge Road, reaching nearly 12,000 feet Explore the wildlife-rich Kawuneeche Valley and Colorado River headwaters Enjoy stops for photos and interpretive stories from knowledgeable guides

title: Boulder Yoga Hikes
overview: If you’re visiting Boulder, this is one of those experiences you’ll be glad you didn’t miss—and very likely the one you’ll end up telling people about when you get home. It’s not just a hike, and not just a yoga class—it’s a feel-good, memorable way to experience the Flatirons that blends movement, nature, and time to actually slow down and take it all in. Instead of rushing through a checklist of sights, this is about being in it—the views, the fresh air, the energy of the mountains, and those unexpected “wow, I needed this” moments along the way. It’s easygoing, welcoming, and designed for all levels, but what makes it special is how it sticks with you afterward. Most people don’t just leave feeling better—they leave talking about it. A true Boulder must-do, and often the highlight people didn’t know they were looking for.
